meta.parties: Maria Et Al. v. Fernando Et Al

rules.statement: An action for defining and settling boundaries lies under the Roman-Dutch law when the boundaries between the lands of neighbours become uncertain and doubtful owing to any cause.
rules.supporting_quote: The action is provided for by the Roman-Dutch law whenever the boundaries of lands belonging to different owners have become uncertain, whether accidentally or through the act of the owners or some third person. (See Voet 10, 1, 1.)
